name: Jude Evan Lloyd
bio: Jude Evan Lloyd is know for Pinocchio: unstrung (2026).

credits.title: Poohniverse: Monsters Assemble
credits.overview: When Peter Pan and Tinker Bell assemble an evil team with Mary Poppins, Winnie and his friends assemble a team to face them. Including Bambi, Piglet, Tigger, Owl, Pinocchio, Mary Poopins, The Little Mermaid and many others.

credits.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
credits.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
